description:
Slow tests are refactored, never excused. Enforcing the per-test limits (f487aeef) on a quiet host showed ten tests over their layer's limit, so this brings each under it before the limits land.

## Background

The limits are the per-layer values in `dev/benchmarks/per-test-durations-1eb949a5/README.md`: 2 s for lib and bin targets, 6 s for `crates/*/tests/*` targets. f487aeef's run on 2026-11-08 at loads 2.81 and 4.79 flagged the same ten:

- Unit (2 s): `storage::claim_coordinator::proptests::test_concurrent_claims_exclusive`, `storage::claim_coordinator::proptests::test_concurrent_different_issues_succeed`; three `redo_conformance` properties (`prop_an_interruption_during_the_records_commit…`, `prop_re_application_after_an_interruption…`, `prop_replay_converges…`); `event_tail_tests::test_mutations_append_over_unparseable_history…`; `commands::gate_check::tests::test_repository_validation_checker_passes_exactly_where_validate_passes`; `profile::tests::test_apply_profiles_jit_dogfood_composes…`.
- Integration (6 s): `profile_cli_tests::test_profile_add_publishes_a_package_whose_directories_outnumber_its_files`, `profile_cli_tests::test_profile_pack_and_add_carry_a_package_at_the_model_limits`.

The prior pass over the benchmark's own list is 4a01ccba.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each listed test runs under its layer's limit in a whole-workspace nextest run on a quiet host (1-minute load below 4), and a committed note under `dev/benchmarks/per-test-durations-1eb949a5/` records each test's measured duration before and after with the run's load.
- [hard] REQ-02: No refactored test sleeps or waits on wall-clock time to observe the property it owns; time-dependent behaviour goes through an injected clock, a channel or an explicit readiness signal.
- [hard] REQ-03: Each refactored test still owns the property it owned before, at the same or a cheaper layer, with no weakened assertion, no ignored test and no test deleted without its property moving to another owning test. A property test that runs fewer cases records in its note entry why the remaining cases still cover the property's input space.

## Notes

If a test cannot meet the limit without losing its property, report it as a blocking concern rather than raising the limit.
title: Bring the tests the enforced limits flagged under their per-test limits
